title: Login UI now describes the graphic challenge as conditional
summary: The frontend fetches and displays a graphic challenge during login preparation, but builds a captcha-free login payload when the field is blank. The Node backend adds captcha and requestSN upstream only when a nonempty captcha was supplied; it does not locally enforce a mandatory captcha. The original UI wording incorrectly implied the graphic code was always required. The label, password/OTP prompts, and help text now explain that it is conditional on DITO requesting it. The frontend comment no longer claims an unverified exact failure-count trigger. PWA cache revision was advanced to 15. Syntax checks passed; no live login, OTP, or purchase was performed.
nextSteps: Keep the challenge available for upstream-required logins. Do not interpret a displayed image as proof that the server requires its answer for every attempt.
